newsitem.title: UK: UK housing starts rise one pct in 3 mths to March.
newsitem.headline: UK housing starts rise one pct in 3 mths to March.

text.p: UK housing starts rose one percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in the three months to March from the previous three, while total completions were down seven percent, the Department of the Environment said on Thursday.
In the latest three months, a total of 48,300 dwellings were started, up 18 percent on the same three months a year ago. Completions totalled 41,600 and were down six percent from a year ago.
Private enterprise housing starts were up one percent and completions were down by two percent.
Housing association starts of new dwellings were virtually unchanged from the previous three months, and completions were fell back.
Both starts and completions by local authorities and government departments remained at a low level, the DOE said.
